# Pinterest Australia

> Pinterest Australia is a visual discovery and social commerce platform connecting users with curated content from verified merchants, creators, and community boards across fashion, hobbies, and lifestyle categories.

au.pinterest.com hosts official brand accounts, user-generated collections, and verified merchants selling apparel and collectibles. The platform serves as both a social discovery tool and e-commerce marketplace with global reach.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest
- Social Commerce
- Verified Merchants
- Apparel Products
- LEGO Creations
- Custom Builds
- Worldwide Shipping
- Pinterest Profiles
- Merchandise Collections
- Hair Inspiration
- DIY Crafts
- Clothing Brands
- Rebrickable
- Cool Shirtz
- User Boards

## Brand & Merchant Accounts

- [Cool Shirtz (coolshirtz) | Official Pinterest account](https://au.pinterest.com/coolshirtz/): Cool Shirtz official Pinterest account for apparel products with worldwide shipping
- [Rebrickable (rebrickable) - Profile | Pinterest](https://au.pinterest.com/rebrickable/): Rebrickable Pinterest profile showcasing LEGO creations and custom builds

## Optional Collections

- [Просмотрите 100 идей на доске «Прически градуированный боб»](https://au.pinterest.com/katerinaspirchenok/прически-градуированный-боб/): User board featuring 100+ graduated bob hairstyle ideas and hair inspiration
- [Торжество Православия](https://au.pinterest.com/ideas/торжество-православия/960364302625/): Pinterest ideas collection for Orthodox religious celebration and spiritual content
- [Büşra DOGRAMACI için 7 fikir](https://au.pinterest.com/mustafadogramaci59/büşra-dogramaci/): User board with DIY bracelet, beaded jewelry, and handmade craft ideas
